items.text: The Windows and Linux apps answer +read and +send-keys from one shared implementation.
The Linux app opens windows and named side panes, and retitles windows, from the ghoztty CLI.
The Linux app closes panes and windows from the ghoztty CLI, and ghoztty:// focus works against it.
The Linux app rearranges a window's panes from a layout.
test/linux/cli-rearrange.sh is executable like its siblings.
One implementation answers +close, focus, +set-state and +set-banner on Windows and Linux.
A crash the test teardown diagnosed is now in the saved transcript of the failed run.
The test-client wiring check now takes its build-subject exemption from the script itself.
A command that exits at once now leaves its "Process exited" notice on screen instead of a blank pane.
A window the agent alone remembered comes back under its own name, not a fresh one.
The agent-recovery wedge test is green again: its I3/I4 red was test timing drift, fixed by T1473.
Typing exit in the fresh shell that replaced a dead session's command now closes the pane.
